attributes.board_name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions – State Board for Social Work

rules.accepted_credit_types: Formal courses from NYSED Department-approved social work CE providers in acceptable subject areas (1 hour = 50 minutes; 1 CEU = 10 hours); also first-time teaching/presentations for approved providers, peer-reviewed articles (2 h), books (5 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the first three-year registration period after licensure (also for a newly licensed LCSW). The first renewal is prorated to move licensees to birth-month renewal; prorated periods need 1 hour per month.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the registration renewal; keep certificates 6 years. Random audits by the Department.

topics.who: All registered licensees (registration periods starting on or after April 1, 2023); counts toward the 36 hours

Applicants for licensure (one-time licensure requirement, not part of the 36 renewal hours): 2-hour Department-approved course on identification and reporting of child abuse and maltreatment; a licensee who never documented it must do so at registration renewal; exemption possible if no professional contact with minors

rules.notes: Self-study max 12 hours per 36 months (1/3 for other period lengths); live online courses unlimited. Holder of both LMSW and LCSW needs only 36 hours. Mandated reporters, including those trained earlier, had to complete the updated child-abuse training curriculum (Ch. 25, Laws of 2024) by Nov 17, 2026.
rules.legal_basis: Education Law Article 154 (§7710); Regulations of the Commissioner §74.10
